title: Where a crosswalk has been reviewed
description: Hand-written, in an import folder beside its polity-crosswalk.yaml (data/imports/<name>/crosswalk-reviewed.yaml): the places and years for which the maintainers have reviewed which of the import's units are the same state as ours. Contested areas are computed only inside them (Phase 5 decision 6). A list of scopes, which shouldn't overlap.

map.description: The source ID of the administered borders the links were reviewed against (openhistoricalmap, or cliopatria where it's the map). The scope counts only for that source's records; without it, for every source's. A crosswalk reviewed against one map says nothing about another's polities.

notes.description: What was reviewed, and where the review is recorded.
